THE MATERIAL STORYTHE SPACE
NATURAL MATERIALS. PERSONAL CHOICES.
01SHARE YOUR SPACE / THE STARTING POINT

Show us the room.
Tell us your vision.

Bring your room measurements, a few photographs and the ideas you have been saving. We build a brief around your space, daily routines and budget.

  • Room dimensions and existing plumbing
  • Your must-haves and preferred style
  • A comfortable budget and timeline
02EXPLORE DESIGNS / FIND YOUR DIRECTION

Try the possibilities.
Find what feels right.

Explore layouts, proportions and lighting in a 3D view of your room. Compare design directions and refine the details before choosing the one to move forward with.

  • Layouts shaped to your dimensions
  • Materials and lighting in context
  • Space to review and refine

↔ Explore the material palette beside the finished space.

03SELECT FINISHES / MAKE IT PERSONAL

The right finish.
In every detail.

Coordinate your faucet, mirror, surfaces and accessories. Explore how each finish changes the mood, then bring your preferred palette into the final design.

  • Compare metal and surface finishes
  • Balance texture, tone and light
  • A cohesive fixture and material schedule

Selected study: Polished chrome

View recent projects ↗
04PLAN INSTALLATION / BRING IT TOGETHER

Every detail agreed.
Ready for the next step.

Review the itemised proposal, fixture positions and installation sequence. Confirm the scope and schedule with your installer before work begins.

  • Final measurements and specification
  • Transparent costs and scope of work
  • Installation sequence and handover plan
